## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: defensive/Healthcare and Consumer Staples leadership (EL (1W: +18.40% | 1M: +27.55%) ABOVE TREND; JNJ (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +4.23%) ABOVE TREND) and Financials (1W: -2.01%) plus Industrials (1W: -2.78%) both weak — this supports a risk-off posture.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Healthcare lead: MRK (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +13.69%) ABOVE TREND. Energy strong: COP (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +12.95%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +5.92%) ABOVE TREND. Materials: FCX (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +20.72%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +11.74% | 1M: +38.91%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Technology weak: INTC (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -10.14%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -8.00% | 1M: -12.31%) BELOW TREND. Industrials weak: HON (1W: -7.72% | 1M: -12.07%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -7.54% | 1M: +2.38%) CORRECTION. Utilities weakest: VST (1W: -8.05% | 1M: -19.39%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: EL (1W: +18.40% | 1M: +27.55%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +20.72%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +11.74% | 1M: +38.91%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +13.69%) ABOVE TREND. **5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: ETN (1W: -7.16% | 1M: +1.23%) CORRECTION, LMT (1W: -7.41% | 1M: -0.88%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -7.54% | 1M: +2.38%) CORRECTION, TJX (1W: -7.61% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND, HON (1W: -7.72% | 1M: -12.07%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Industrials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Top 1W movers: EL (1W: +18.40% | 1M: +27.55%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +20.72%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%) ABOVE TREND; downside momentum in INTC (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -10.14%) BELOW TREND. Major divergence among mega-caps (MSFT (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +26.88%) CORRECTION; NVDA (1W: -4.64% | 1M: +2.85%) CORRECTION; AMZN (1W: -1.53% | 1M: +10.69%) CORRECTION) — watch for trend break.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Technology in CORRECTION overall (1W: -1.85% across 24 stocks) with NVDA (1W: -4.64% | 1M: +2.85%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +26.88%) CORRECTION, AAPL (1W: +1.12% | 1M: -3.74%) RECOVERY, CRM (1W: +6.61% | 1M: +33.29%) ABOVE TREND — mixed internals and leadership thinning.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials are showing strain (1W: -2.01% across 20 stocks) with JPM (1W: -3.10% | 1M: +0.48%) CORRECTION while V (1W: +1.89% | 1M: +5.73%) ABOVE TREND and MA (1W: +1.99% | 1M: +9.49%) ABOVE TREND — watch credit/bank news flow and weak sector breadth.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare leading (1W: +3.76% across 17 stocks) with MRK (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +13.69%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +4.23%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +6.38% | 1M: +6.01%) ABOVE TREND — defensive bid confirmed.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor defensive Healthcare and select Staples (JNJ (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +4.23%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +14.20%) ABOVE TREND, EL (1W: +18.40% | 1M: +27.55%) ABOVE TREND) and Materials/Energy carry trades (FCX, COP). Reduce exposure to high-beta Technology and weak Industrials (NVDA (1W: -4.64% | 1M: +2.85%) CORRECTION, INTC (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -10.14%) BELOW TREND); style: mixed but defensive/value tilt.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: LLY (1W: +6.38% | 1M: +6.01%) ABOVE TREND (positive momentum/news), FCX (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +20.72%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +12.95%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: INTC (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -10.14%) BELOW TREND, AVGO (news -55) with downside risk, WMT (1W: -9.82% | 1M: -4.11%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Healthcare (1W: +3.76%) and Materials/Energy (Materials 1W: +1.12%; Energy 1W: +2.91%) for continued leadership. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -1.85%) and Industrials (1W: -2.78%) where downside momentum could continue.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA: monitor near prior short-term support/resistance (watch for break of recent 1W range) — CORRECTION risk. AAPL: watch support at the recent pullback area as RECOVERY confirmation (AAPL (1W: +1.12% | 1M: -3.74%) RECOVERY). JPM: watch for continuation if it reclaims near-term range (JPM (1W: -3.10% | 1M: +0.48%) CORRECTION). FCX: sustained move above recent highs would confirm cyclicals (FCX (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +20.72%) ABOVE TREND).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
LLY (+55): Eli Lilly (1W: +6.38% | 1M: +6.01%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and price confirming breakout on weight‑loss leadership. COP (+60): ConocoPhillips (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +12.95%) ABOVE TREND — earnings beat and CEO change confirming. FCX (+50): Freeport-McMoRan (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +20.72%) ABOVE TREND — commodity demand/news confirmed by strong price action.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
INTC (-55): Intel (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -10.14%) BELOW TREND — negative headline confirms distribution. AVGO (-55): Broadcom (1W: -X% | 1M: +Y%) CORRECTION — news negative versus chip peers; monitor price (note: price moved lower on Marvell/Google AI chip shift). XOM (-50): Exxon (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +5.92%) ABOVE TREND — bearish headline vs rising price is a divergence to watch.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF with a defensive/value tilt. MRK (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +20.72%) ABOVE TREND and EL (1W: +18.40% | 1M: +27.55%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk: major-cap divergence (MSFT, NVDA, AMZN showing 1W weakness vs 1M strength) and negative headlines on INTC — watch for trend breaks and sentiment-driven dispersion.
